item.title: Delhi High Court: No Interest Payable on Delayed Salary when delay attributable to employee’s own conduct
item.description: “Petitioner did not sign the pre-receipts, mandatory for drawing salary, and also did not submit his bank details. The petitioner’s own conduct and non-cooperative attitude contributed to the delay in release of payments.” The post Delhi High Court: No Interest Payable on Delayed Salary when delay attributable to employee’s own conduct appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Kerala HC quashes criminal proceedings against brothel customer after finding no inducement of prostitution
item.description: “Section 3, Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 1956 deals with the punishment for keeping a brothel or allowing premises to be used as a brothel, and the said provision has no application to the petitioner who is alleged to be merely a customer.” The post Kerala HC quashes criminal proceedings against brothel customer after finding no inducement of prostitution appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: NCERT Class-8 textbook Judiciary Chapter| SC takes suo motu cognisance, orders nationwide withdrawal, issues contempt notice
item.description: Observing that decontextualised criticism in a school curriculum may undermine institutional dignity and influence impressionable minds, the Supreme Court ordered seizure of all copies of the NCERT Grade-8 textbook and issued show-cause notices for criminal contempt. The post NCERT Class-8 textbook Judiciary Chapter| SC takes suo motu cognisance, orders nationwide withdrawal, issues contempt notice appeared first on SCC Times.
